verdict.rationale: The published front pages show an entry path that needs no account. The Unternehmensregister has a quick search by company name or EUID, and handelsregister.de offers normal and advanced search plus public register announcements. That covers the read/lookup side of the flow, but nothing shows the filing side (e.g., the publication platform order flow) can be started without an account, and no page explicitly states that no login is needed. Missing for 10: an explicit no-account/keyless statement, a documented account-free start for the filing/submission flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
